structural_change: KV-NATIVE 10-17 sched_s10 (PINREG 2) successor of sched_s9: routed native audit of qkd_ctrl_pc_sched_s9-s9-623df1d3e (receipt claude/native-batch-1017 029f539c5, results/arch/native_batch_1017/native_batch_audit.json) FAILS launch on 10 pins e_sec[0..10] 243.1-245.8 > 220 = the 2:1 select of the es0/es1 (er0/er1) registers by the kept p_kv_v copies AFTER the edge. Fix (coordinator-approved +1 cycle class): the select result is registered at the pin (e_sec_p / e_row_p), e_sec / e_row = s9 one hclk later; the cycle is absorbed in the ECC child successor qkd_ctrl_pc_ecc_child_sl (section / row enter its P1 stage), so the landed return is unchanged on every edge. Same 116.64 x 108 slot and pin faces.
